sentiment.instructions: What is the sentiment of this financial text toward the stock price or company outlook?

criteria.bearish: negative for the stock price or outlook
criteria.neutral: no clear price impact, or purely factual
criteria.bullish: positive for the stock price or outlook

topic.instructions: What type of financial news event is this?

criteria.analyst_update: analyst rating or price target change
criteria.stock_movement: a stock moving up or down

fomc.instructions: What is the monetary policy stance of this central bank text?

headline.instructions: Does the news headline talk about price?

term_domain.instructions: Which area of finance does this passage's terminology belong to?

criteria.equity_valuation: valuing stocks, equity research, fundamentals, multiples
criteria.fixed_income: bonds, yields, duration, credit spreads, term structure
criteria.derivatives: options, futures, swaps, pricing and greeks
criteria.portfolio_theory: portfolio construction, CAPM, factors, allocation, performance measurement
criteria.risk_management: VaR, drawdown, hedging, position sizing, tail risk
criteria.corporate_finance: capital structure, M&A, budgeting, dividends, financing
criteria.accounting_reporting: financial statements, GAAP/IFRS, earnings quality, audit
criteria.macro_monetary: central banks, inflation, rates, GDP, economic cycles
criteria.market_structure: trading venues, order types, liquidity, execution, microstructure
criteria.technical_analysis: chart patterns, indicators, trend and momentum rules, backtested trading systems
criteria.quant_methods: statistics, econometrics, machine learning, time series, optimization
criteria.banking_credit: lending, bank regulation, credit risk, insurance

trading_style.instructions: Which kind of trading approach does this passage mainly describe?

criteria.trend_following: following sustained price trends with moving averages, channels or trend filters
criteria.mean_reversion: fading extremes, oversold/overbought bounces, reversion to a mean
criteria.breakout_momentum: breakouts, range expansion, momentum or relative-strength ranking
criteria.options_volatility: options strategies, implied/realized volatility, volatility trading
criteria.seasonality_cycles: calendar effects, seasonality, market cycles and timing
criteria.risk_position_sizing: stops, position sizing, drawdown control, hedging, money management
criteria.system_validation: backtesting, optimization, walk-forward, overfitting, performance evaluation
criteria.indicator_construction: building or explaining a technical indicator or chart tool
criteria.commentary_education: market commentary, platform/software, interviews or general trading education
